title: enhanced-movement
description: A mod that enables double jump, dash in any direction, and ledge grabbing! Enhanced with modern config GUI.
body:
![Enhanced Movement](https://i.imgur.com/jzeRbXp.png)
                                                                                                                                                                             
# Enhanced Movement

**Move like you're running a Sandevistan.** Enhanced Movement adds fast, skill-based traversal to Minecraft — **double jump**, **dash in any direction**, **ledge grab**, and a glowing **Edgerunners-style afterimage trail** that streaks behind you every time you dash.

Built for both **Fabric** and **NeoForge**, multiplayer-aware, and fully configurable in-game.

---

## ✨ Features

### ⏫ Double Jump
Tap jump again in mid-air for a second boost. Comes with **smart fall-damage protection** — short drops from the top of your double jump cost nothing, but real falls still hurt. You get the air time without trivializing fall damage.

### 💨 Directional Dash
**Double-tap a movement key** (W / A / S / D) to dash that way — or flip on **keybind mode** and bind a dedicated dash key (perfect for mouse side buttons) to dash wherever you're moving. Dashing works **in mid-air** too, with a tuned air-dash speed so jump-dash chains feel deliberate, not infinite. Dashes carry the same fall-damage protection.

### 🧗 Ledge Grab
Just barely missed the jump? Hold jump near an edge and Ledge Grab gives you the nudge to stick the landing.

### 👻 Dash Afterimages — *Sandevistan Mode*
Every dash leaves a trail of glowing cyan ghosts blurring behind you — the anime time-slow look. Flip on **Prism Mode** for a full rainbow spectrum instead. The trail is **shader-pack compatible** (Iris / Oculus) and **visible to nearby players**, so in multiplayer everyone sees you blink across the fight.

### 🍗 Balanced by Hunger
Like sprinting, dashing and double-jumping draw on your food bar — so movement is a resource you manage, not a free pass.

---

## ⚙️ Fully Configurable
Tune everything in-game via **Mod Menu** (Fabric) or the **config button** on the NeoForge mods list:

- **Double jump** — power (boost %) and timing window
- **Dash** — cooldown, air-dash on/off, double-tap vs. dedicated keybind
- **Afterimages** — count, fade duration, and Prism (rainbow) mode
- **General** — option to disable all features while sneaking

Settings are stored in `config/enhancedmovement.json` and carry across updates.

---

## 📦 Loaders & Versions
- **Fabric** — requires Fabric API (Mod Menu optional, for the config screen)
- **NeoForge** — no extra dependencies

Enhanced Movement targets several Minecraft versions — **check the Versions tab and grab the file that matches your Minecraft version and loader.** Java requirement varies by Minecraft version (listed on each file).

---

## 💬 Why?
I like movement. I like double jumping. I like dashing. So I built the mod I wanted to play, and tried to make it feel good in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

Released under **CC0-1.0 (public domain)** — use it, learn from it, build on it, do whatever you want.
